openspec.note: The installed CLI is authoritative over prose (spec §16). On codex the OPSX core profile materialises as six project-local skills, not /opsx:* slash commands.

brainstorm_ui.fires_when: the change has a UI surface and design.md lacks a Design alternatives section

brainstorm_architecture.fires_when: the change adds a service/model/integration/data shape and design.md lacks an Architecture alternatives section

design_shotgun.fires_when: UI change with no design contract for the surface yet

design_critique.fires_when: UI change with an existing design contract, OR as the filter step in design-shotgun

multi_ai_review.excluded_vendor: codex — the implementing host never reviews its own change
multi_ai_review.collapses: the 0.x plan-review gate (§17) — kept as the change-gate predicate, not as a standalone gate

change_gate.predicate: openspec validate --all is GREEN AND every active change carries REVIEWS.md with >= 2 reviewers
change_gate.exempt: writes under openspec/** — the agent must be able to author the change while gated
change_gate.fail_open: on parse error only; never on policy

verification.fires_when: always — before any task transitions to complete

code_review.fires_when: always — after the tasks are implemented, in independent agent context
code_review.note: openspec validate is a spec check, not a code review, and never discharges this (§17)

security.fires_when: the change touches auth, storage, request handling, secrets, or an LLM trust boundary

database_security.fires_when: the change touches SQL, schema, RLS, definer functions, or storage policy

qa.fires_when: the change ships user-visible behavior AND a dev server is reachable on a local port

ui_preview.fires_when: a task modifies a frontend component, route, or visual surface

impeccable_audit.fires_when: the change alters a shipping visual surface
impeccable_audit.retention: ADR-0021 measured trial (MEASUREMENT.md) — retained under measurement, not conviction

ts_declare_first.fires_when: the change adds a new TypeScript module's API surface
ts_declare_first.binding: CI lint / tdd-strengthener — demoted from a standalone gate at 1.0.0 (§17)

archive.done_ness: the spec delta is folded into openspec/specs/<capability>/spec.md AND openspec validate --all is green (§16)

branch_close.fires_when: the change is archived and the branch is ready to merge
branch_close.note: archive != ship (§17) — this is the separate git act

db_pre_launch_audit.fires_when: before first production launch, after a major DB migration

linear.coupling: loose — a change SHOULD reference its Linear issue ID in proposal.md or the ship commit; no sync is built or required (§19)
